expenditures.detail: The 7 Schedule B rows sum to 207.38 + 8.00 + 20.40 + 64.46 + 3646.50 + 132.69 + 232.09 = 4311.52 exactly — equal to the page subtotal, the schedule's grand total, and Box D. Nothing was inferred from that pairing; each side reconciles on its own printed figures.

itemized.notes: modern_boxAF, form revision v. 12.23, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' (LAST — located by content). NO CHECKLIST bound. pdfinfo: 4 pages, EVERY PAGE /Rotate 270, rendered upright portrait. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment ticked NO; Date of Report 10/25/24 on all four sheets, foliated 1/2/3/4; signed in blue ink. THE DOCUMENTED CLERK NAME-DRIFT, CONFIRMED AT THE SOURCE: the file is named '2024_Brian_Baird.pdf' and index.csv's channel label reads 'Brian Baird', but THE PAGE FACE READS **BRIAN BIRD** — in the Name of Candidate box, in the affirmation line ('I, Brian Bird'), in the Name-of-Candidate box at the foot of all three following sheets, in the donor rows where he records his own self-funding, and in his own email address (brianlbird@...). The page face governs; the divergence is recorded here rather than resolved, and the channel's label is preserved as the disagreement it is. This is the Farren/Farron and Guernsey/Gurnsey class. THE OFFICE BOX NAMES NO OFFICE: it contains a MAILING ADDRESS (a street, suite and city/zip) instead of an office title, which is why index.csv leaves `office` blank for this row — this is the module's documented honestly-unresolved 'Bird 2024'. No office was inferred; the address in that box is deliberately not reproduced here. SUMMARY BOXES CROSS-CHECKED AGAINST THE SHEET HEADINGS (L1 screen): Schedule A's total lands in Box B and Schedule B's in Box D — no swap; A = $0.00, F = $4,311.52 = A + B, close box $0.00 = F - D, so the ladder is internally consistent. PRIVACY — THIS FILING IS PUBLISHED WHOLLY UNREDACTED: the candidate's own street address, phone number and email are in the clear on the cover, and every donor row on Schedule A carries a full street line. NONE of that is carried into this record — donor rows keep city/state only, expenditure rows carry no address field at all, and no street address or phone number appears in any note. The filenames without '_Redacted' are consistent with what the pages show here, but a filename is never the evidence: redaction was judged per cell off the page.
